notes: Source is a UTF-16 tab-separated extract (商品.tsv) with a single sheet/tab '商品' of 12 data rows and no hidden rows, formulas or error cells; leading-zero SKUs such as 00470001 must be read as text.

Only one price list ('standard') and one unit ('PCS') and one currency ('JPY') exist, so the product table yields exactly one /prices entry per SKU; no effective_from/effective_to dates exist in this file, so those optional keys stay null rather than being invented.
No inventory, promotion, category, brand, barcode, status or description columns are present; these optional target fields are left unmapped instead of being guessed from the product name.

tables.reason: Single product master sheet: one row per unique product code (12 codes, 12 rows, no repeats), each with a Japanese product name, currency, sell unit, and a single 'standard' price list. The price columns are attributes of each product row, so the table is a product master that carries one pricing record per SKU rather than a separate pricing ledger.

columns.name: 商品コード
columns.reason: Header means 'product code'; 12 rows, 12 distinct values, one per row (unique_ratio 1.0), samples 00470001–00470012 with leading zeros that must be kept as text. This is the product identity of the sheet.

columns.name: 商品名
columns.reason: Header means 'product name'; distinct per row, free text samples such as 'テスト商品 1'–'テスト商品 12'. Required product_name field.

columns.name: 通貨
columns.reason: Header means 'currency'; every row holds the single ISO code 'JPY' (12/12), matching a 3-letter currency pattern. Value is explicit in the row, so it is not inferred from the Japanese headers.

columns.name: 単位
columns.reason: Header means 'unit / unit of measure'; the only value is 'PCS' (12/12), which is in the sell_unit enum_hint and the built-in unit table knows it. No pack-size evidence exists in this sheet, so only the sell unit is mapped.

columns.name: 価格リスト
columns.reason: Header means 'price list'; every row is 'standard' (12/12), which the operator instruction says to use explicitly. This supplies the required price_list identity key for the single price record per product.

columns.name: 税抜価格
columns.reason: Header means 'price excluding tax' (税抜 = tax-excluded); integer values 1234–2334, distinct per product, all non-negative. It supplies the unit price amount. Because the header states the price is tax-excluded, vat_included must be false; the separate 税込 column independently agrees.

columns.name: 税込
columns.reason: Header literally means 'tax included (yes/no)'; the only value is 'いいえ' = 'no' (12/12). This is the false flag of the same price record, agreeing with the 税抜価格 header. It is a per-price boolean, not a separate numeric price column (no numeric parse).

columns.name: 税率
columns.reason: Header means 'tax rate'; values are the percent string '5%' (12/12, percent hint). Converted with parse_number_th(percent_to_fraction=true) this becomes 0.05, the fraction form the vat_rate field expects; it is an explicit source rate, not a default.

changes_from_draft: Replaced fallback /sku trim with a confirmed mapping from 商品コード, documented as text so leading zeros (00470001…) survive; the draft's own open question about the identity column is now resolved by 12/12 unique values.
Fixed /currency: the draft hard-coded THB; the source column 通貨 says 'JPY' on all 12 rows, so currency is read from the row instead of defaulted.
Added /product_name from 商品名 (required target field, was unmapped in the draft).
Added /unit/sell_unit via unit_normalize on 単位 ('PCS' 12/12); /unit/pack_size left unmapped because no pack-size evidence exists in this sheet.

Added the /prices collection (one item per SKU, linked on 商品コード) with price_list='standard' from 価格リスト, amount from 税抜価格, vat_included=false from 税込='いいえ', vat_rate=0.05 from 税率='5%' (percent→fraction).
No effective_from/effective_to dates exist in the source, so those optional price keys remain null instead of being invented.
No inventory, promotion, category, brand, barcode, status or description columns exist; those optional targets stay unmapped rather than being derived from the product name.
Set attributes_passthrough=false because every source column is consumed by a declared mapping (the price columns are represented inside /prices), avoiding duplicate copies under /attributes.
Explicit source values (JPY currency, PCS unit, 5% fictional fixture tax rate, tax-exclusive pricing) are recorded here as information, not raised as questions.
